prompt:
S#1. 302호 거실 — 브이로그 · 0~10초
삐빅, 녹화 시작음. 렌즈 바로 앞에 아이 손바닥이 확 덮였다가 떨어진다. 초점이 안 맞았다 맞았다 하며, 화면 가득 주인공 얼굴. 팔을 쭉 뻗은 셀카 구도라 화면이 계속 기울고 흔들린다.
주인공 안녕하세요! 행복아파트 119동, 오늘의 브이로그 시작합니다!
카메라가 휙 돌아가 형을 찾는다. 창문 박스에 테이프를 붙이던 형이 화면에 잡힌다.
주인공 여긴 우리 형이고요~
형이 손바닥으로 렌즈를 확 막는다.
형 형 찍지 마. (살짝 무심한 말투로)
카메라가 바닥으로 확 떨어지듯 내려가 꼬리를 붕붕 흔드는 콩이를 잡는다. 콩이가 렌즈에 코를 들이밀며 킁킁거려서, 동그란 코와 까만 눈이 화면 가득 커다랗게 잡힌다.  
(원근감 레퍼런스: 위 이미지처럼 광각으로 코와 얼굴은 크게, 몸은 작게 잡혀서 최대한 귀엽게~!)
주인공 이건 우리 막내 콩이! 그리고 우리 누나는… 지금 잠깐 나갔나 봐요!
S#2. 302호 현관 — 브이로그 · 10~17초
주인공이 카메라를 든 채 형을 졸졸 따라다닌다. 카메라는 형 얼굴, 천장, 바닥을 오가며 정신없이 흔들린다.
주인공 형, 오늘은 나 밖에서 놀아도 돼?
형 안 돼.
주인공 왜애~ 딱 한 번만!
형 위험하다 했잖아. 안 되는 건 안 되는 거야.
형의 마지막 대사가 들리는 동안, 카메라는 아래로 처져 화면 구석의 콩이를 잡고 있다. 콩이는 귀를 쫑긋 세우고 열린 현관문 너머를 노려본다.
콩이 월! 월!
콩이가 뛰쳐나간다.
주인공 어?! 콩아!

environment.overview: A contemporary Korean apartment interior uses plaster walls, concrete construction, laminate flooring, painted cabinetry, and glass in pale-to-mid grays, with dark doorframes and soft overcast daylight.
environment.location_type: Apartment living room and entrance, indoors, adjoining an enclosed communal landing.

zones.name: Living Room
zones.description: Pale walls, a broad window showing a featureless light-gray sky, a low fabric sofa, a small rug, laminate flooring, and a packing box beside the window with a loose strip of sealing tape

zones.name: Entryway
zones.description: A recessed tiled shoe-removal area below the raised laminate floor, a tall closed shoe cabinet, a ceiling light, several neatly paired shoes, and an open steel apartment door in a dark frame

zones.name: Communal Landing
zones.description: A plain enclosed corridor immediately outside the apartment, with light-gray walls, darker floor tiles, a concrete ceiling, and steady overhead lighting; no people or identifiable threat are visible

baseline.lighting: soft window daylight inside the apartment, supplemented by steady entrance and corridor ceiling lights.

breakdown.logline: An exuberant child filming a family vlog wants permission to play outside, but an older brother’s firm refusal becomes sudden alarm when their little dog Kong bolts through the open apartment door.

beats.summary: The child starts recording and confidently introduces the apartment vlog
The child turns the family introduction toward an older brother occupied with taping a box
The brother blocks the lens and refuses to participate
Kong becomes the enthusiastic subject of the family roll call, while the sister remains unaccounted for
Following the brother into the entrance, the child asks permission to play outside
The brother refuses, and the child tries pleading instead
As the brother reiterates the danger, Kong becomes fixated on the open doorway
Kong barks and escapes through the doorway, provoking the child’s alarm

subjects.name: Vlogger
subjects.kind: Young child, approximately ten years old
subjects.appearance: short, compact build; rounded bowl-cut dark hair; oversized pale sweatshirt with broad, loose cuffs; dark straight trousers
signature_features: unusually broad sweatshirt silhouette on a small body, with oversized cuffs recognizable even when only a hand and forearm enter the frame.

subjects.name: Brother
subjects.appearance: tall, lanky build; short dark hair; plain charcoal long-sleeved shirt; light-gray straight trousers
signature_features: elongated, narrow silhouette and strong dark-upper-body/light-lower-body division readable from any direction.

subjects.name: Kong
subjects.appearance: compact, rounded body on short legs; pale short coat; upright triangular ears; tightly curled tail; broad dark collar; dark eyes and rounded black nose
signature_features: low, bean-shaped proportions and curled tail distinguish the dog from any angle; the oversized-looking nose becomes especially prominent near the wide-angle lens.

spec.shot_name: Vlogger uncovering the lens and greeting the audience
spec.angle: eye level, slightly canted selfie perspective
spec.backdrop: A narrow, tilted strip of pale wall and the upper edge of the fabric sofa.
spec.action: The child’s withdrawing palm remains at the edge of the frame while their eager face fills the image. A recording beep sounds; focus briefly hunts before catching the eyes. The child says, “Hello! Happy Apartments, Building 119, today’s vlog starts now!”
spec.transition: Hard cut on the beginning of a fast turn toward the brother.
